items.title: Why Procter & Gamble (PG) Is Getting Attention Today
items.summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) just delivered fiscal Q1 2027 earnings and revenue that came in ahead of analyst expectations, as stronger sales volumes, Tide evo uptake, and its automation push lifted investor interest.
